description: Build the complete premium announcement bar section (sections/custom.liquid) with all 18 premium features: multiple display modes (slider/fade/marquee), countdown timer, dismiss with sessionStorage, per-message links and icons, full color/gradient/typography customization, auto-rotate with hover pause, mobile visibility toggle, navigation arrows, dot indicators, and complete Shopify Theme Editor integration.
steps: Completely rewrite sections/custom.liquid with the full premium announcement bar implementation
HTML structure: wrapper with data attributes, inner container with arrows, slider/fade/marquee content area, close button, dots, countdown timer
Block type 'message' with settings: text (text field), link (url field optional), icon (select with emoji/icon options)

Section settings organized by headers: Display Mode (select: slider/fade/marquee), Colors (bg color, text color, arrow color, gradient toggle + gradient color 2 + direction select), Bar Size (height range 32-60 step 2 default 44), Typography (font size 10-18 step 1 default 13, weight select, transform select, letter spacing 0-20 step 1 default 0), Rotation (auto-rotate checkbox, speed 2-10 step 1 default 5), Controls (arrows checkbox, dots checkbox, close button checkbox), Countdown (enable checkbox, end_date text, expired_message text), Mobile (hide_on_mobile checkbox), Marquee (marquee_speed range)

Scoped CSS using #sab-{{ section.id }} with CSS custom properties, responsive design at 749px breakpoint, @media (prefers-reduced-motion) support, gradient background support, marquee keyframes animation, slide/fade transition modes

Inline IIFE JavaScript handling: display mode switching (slider=translateY, fade=opacity, marquee=CSS animation), auto-rotation with setInterval, hover pause, arrow/dot navigation, close button with sessionStorage, countdown timer (parse date, calculate remaining, update DOM every second, show expired message), Shopify editor events (shopify:section:load, shopify:block:select, shopify:block:deselect), keyboard accessibility (arrow keys), window resize recalculation
Schema with tag:section, class:sab-section, presets with 3 default messages, blocks limit 10
All range settings must satisfy (max-min)/step <= 100 and default = min + (N * step)
Every block root element must include {{ block.shopify_attributes }}
acceptance_criteria: sections/custom.liquid contains a complete premium announcement bar with HTML, scoped CSS, inline JS, and valid JSON schema
Schema has display_mode select with slider/fade/marquee options
Schema has countdown timer settings (enable, end_date, expired_message)
Schema has gradient settings (enable, second color, direction)
Block type message has text, link, and icon settings
All range settings pass validation: (max-min)/step <= 100, default on step grid
JS handles all three display modes with proper transitions
JS handles countdown timer with live updating
Presets array is present for Theme Customizer 'Add section'
verification: Run: python3 -c "import json; f=open('/projects/sandbox/new1/sections/custom.liquid','r'); content=f.read(); schema_start=content.index('{%- schema -%}' if '{%- schema -%}' in content else '{% schema %}'); schema_end=content.index('{%- endschema -%}' if '{%- endschema -%}' in content else '{% endschema %}'); json.loads(content[schema_start+len('{% schema %}'):schema_end]); print('Schema JSON valid')"

Verify the file contains all key features by checking for: display_mode, countdown, marquee, gradient, hide_on_mobile, sessionStorage, shopify:block:select, prefers-reduced-motion, block.shopify_attributes
